description: Wannipura Gamage Malini Chandrika v. P. Susantha Jayathilaka, Divisional Secretary, Nikawaratiya & Another Wannipura Gamage Malini Chandrika v. P. Susantha Jayathilaka, Divisional Secretary, Nikawaratiya & Another View More before Hon. Vijith K. Malalgoda, PC, J (P/CA)
parties: Wannipura Gamage Malini Chandrika v. P. Susantha Jayathilaka, Divisional Secretary, Nikawaratiya & Another Wannipura Gamage Malini Chandrika v. P. Susantha Jayathilaka, Divisional Secretary, Nikawaratiya & Another View More
judgement_by: Hon. Vijith K. Malalgoda, PC, J (P/CA)
keywords: Certiorari and Prohibition – Quit notice – Previous Court of Appeal determination in CA Writ 2033/2005 that “Galagoda Henayaya” was private land and not State land – Divisional Secretary nevertheless issuing quit notice for same land – Respondents declining to contest and agreeing to abide by prior decision – State-land recovery procedure unavailable against private land – Quit notice quashed and prohibition issued against ejectment pursuant to it. P. Padman Surasena J. agreed.
legistation: Constitution – Article 140; State Lands (Recovery of Possession) legislation governing the impugned quit notice; the short order does not identify a specific section.
